about: What OSV and NVD publish against the Graphviz inside @viz-js/viz (both are asked, and their answers merged), and what OSV publishes against @viz-js/viz, for the versions in "queried", as of "checked". Written by node scripts/engine-version.mjs --refresh, never by hand; the release runs it, and the Engine advisories workflow watches for a change. The check reads this file offline, and fails if it was made for another engine or lists a flaw that affects this one.
